faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University College Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Delhi University College Counsellor position is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the College Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in specific psychology or social work disciplines, along with a relevant diploma/certification in counselling and 3-5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job type for the College Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The job type for the College Counsellor post is Part Time.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their complete application with bio-data and required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the College Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves shortlisting of applications received from eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Does Delhi University provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly detailed in the provided data; candidates should refer to the official notification for specifics.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the College Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of College Counsellor announced by Delhi University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the College Counsellor position?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to have 3-5 years of relevant experience in counselling or psychosocial support, preferably in an educational setting.
